stories.title: Announcements do not get people to work: MS demands dates for £20m Flintshire bus plan
stories.summary: The First Minister has said improved bus links to Deeside Industrial Park will move into implementation by the end of the 2027-28 financial year.

stories.title: Some DWP online services offline after cyber incident, but benefit payments not affected
stories.summary: Some Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) online services have been taken offline after a cyber incident. The DWP said regular benefit and pension payments are not affected and will be paid as normal. stories.title: Blackmail is most common crime linked to Instagram in North Wales, police figures show
stories.summary: Blackmail is the most common crime linked to Instagram in North Wales this year, police figures show. North Wales Police, which covers Flintshire, has listed 65 occurrences recorded in 2026 where Instagram was mentioned in the occurrence summary. Of those, 27 were recorded as blackmail. stories.title: Burst water main leaves parts of Holywell with low pressure or no water
stories.summary: A burst water main is affecting supplies in parts of Holywell this morning, Dŵr Cymru has said. The water company’s incident map shows the affected area covers parts of Holway and Bryn Celyn. stories.title: Labour’s Laura Murton wins Mold Broncoed by-election
stories.summary: Labour’s Laura Murton has won the Mold Broncoed by-election, keeping the Flintshire County Council seat for her party. She received 250 votes, ahead of Reform UK Wales candidate Richard Clarke on 197. Welsh Liberal Democrat Nanette Davies came third with 139 votes.
